description: Use this when the user asks for news, headlines or recent developments behind a prediction market or topic — for example "any news on the Fed October decision?", "what's in the news about Bitcoin ETFs?", "any headlines behind the move in the Fed October odds?", or "latest news on Gavin Newsom 2028". Pass a market (a slug from search_markets, or a supported market or event link) and/or topic words. Returns up to 10 headlines (default 5) from the last 14 days with the outlet, publish time and link, ranked by how many of the market's key names and terms they mention, newest first among equals. Headlines come from PredictionScan's news feed of major outlets (politics, economy, crypto, sports, entertainment): it is not a full web search, returns no article text, and may find nothing for niche markets.

market.description: The market to find news for: a market_slug or event_slug from search_markets (e.g. 'fed-decision-in-october-20260617190323537'), a supported market or event link, or a condition id. Plain words are treated as the topic.

query.description: Topic words to search the news for, e.g. 'bitcoin etf', 'fed rate decision', 'us recession'. With a market, keeps only that market's news that mentions these words.

name: get_market_news
title: Get market news
